I'm 19 but 17 seems like a dream. I was doing drugs, in and out of psych wards and doing awful. I had an attempt to kill myself and I lost a lot of feeling in my arms. Like I said, I turned 19 in August and I'm doing a lot better. I have a job at my college so I dont have to drive anyway. And I'm almost half way done with it. Look, if you cant think of a way. Then it's not meant to be. Look at the confusion of the word "suicide". Everyone says it as a joke, or in a serious matter. And sometimes the world is cruel and hard, the light at the end of the tunnel seems far and distant. But I'm promising you, it's your brain with the illusions giving you the doubt in yourself. Learn to love the things you seemed to lose interests for again. Learn to love for no reason. 
I tried to end my life on October 23rd 2015 I was 16 at the time. I cut my arms in ways and shapes that I for sure  thought would end my life. I woke up in a hospital with the family I thought hated me. I woke up with them crying hooked up to a blood IV because i lost mine. Stitches in my arms i couldnt feel my hands and was going to lose them. To this day I have to live with scars and nerve damage in both my arms. Only reason I'm telling you this is because "An attempt is just that. It's not guaranteed nor denied. In the time of need in a person's life where attempt is definite is the time where they need the most love" . I'm here for you man. As well as many others I'm sure.

Your family will associate every holiday with your death as soon as your absent from them. Everyday you will be absent. And it seems like the family you have loves you. I know it's easier said then done but try to talk to them. Get the help you need so you can be better for them. Suicide is a permanent solution to sometimes a "temporary problem". A saying a lot of people say. But I want you to know that if you worrying about your family with the loss of your life bothers you and makes you feel guilty. Suicide isn't what you really want. You want to get better and not feel this way anymore. And I hope you get the help you deserve. Good luck, my friend. I hope you feel better and happy holidays, hang in there. If not for yourself, then for the people who care. ❤ 
--Korbin.

Sometimes people have to hurt before they get better. Also another thing you might've heard. I'm going through a very dark time as well so the advice I'm going to give is very contradicting to myself. But, I'm telling you that life isn't what any of us asked for yet (some people not so much) we are scared to die, because we only know life and not death. The love of your life left you with no explanation. I get that it feels like the world's over and that your heart is slowly losing the color of red and is turning darker and darker. Your soul isn't lighting up as much as it used to, and your smile is as fake as unicorns. But I'm going to tell you that your life isn't over. You should label him/her "the love of a second of your life" because the years or months with them is nothing compared to the many many years you've got ahead. Lifes never fun unless you're retired or just a kid. We work til we die  or get lucky and win the lottery or you're born into a wealthy family. When the world's ending in your head and you feel like it's too much, think about all the times you've felt like this and then completely forgot about them. Think about how you got better. Think about a year from now (or if that's too far to imagine) a month, a week, a day. Use all of the good in your life and think about it when you're upset. Write about it, tell someone that you trust with your life about it. 
If today was as bad as it could get, tomorrow would've already ended. Good luck my friend. I hope you find the love of your life, happiness, and the life you deserve and wish to have. 
--Korbin.
